title: Beira Warehouse Recount 1: Rows A–F, Unsigned

fields.organization: Harbourlight Relief International: Mozambique Country Office, Logistics, Beira Warehouse
fields.location: Beira warehouse, port logistics zone: racking rows A–F, side door, floor area under the roof breach (rows C–E)
fields.weather: Showers easing, overcast, gusty. Rain still coming through the roof over rows C–E. Standing water about 5 cm on the floor.
fields.summary: RECOUNT 1, rows A–F, pallet by pallet. NOT YET SIGNED BY LOGISTICS MANAGER. Shelter kits: 3,000 on sheet → 2,400 usable / 520 wet (tool bags rusting, tarps OK but kits incomplete) / 80 missing. Jerrycans: 2,800 → 2,260 usable / 60 crushed / 480 missing (side door). Hygiene kits: 4,000 → 3,180 usable / 620 wet / 200 missing. Portable water treatment units: 12 → 10 usable / 2 wet boxes in row D, NOT TESTED. Water tablets and nets in rows A–B are dry. Voice note: "Chefe, the cluster logistics officer called and asked if he can still list our 3,000 shelter kits for Nhamatanda. I said ask you."

findings.notes: Sheet 3,000. Usable 2,400. Wet 520: tarps OK, tool bags rusting, kits incomplete. Missing 80.
Sheet 2,800. Usable 2,260. Crushed 60. Missing 480, near the side door.
Sheet 4,000. Usable 3,180. Wet 620. Missing 200. Two pallets split open.
Sheet 12. 10 boxes dry. 2 boxes wet, NOT TESTED. Do not count the 2 wet units until checked.
Roof sheets gone over the north-east third. Rain still entering.
Forced or blown open. Not secured overnight. Stock missing from the area near it.

actionsTaken: Recounted rows A–F pallet by pallet with 2 daily workers, 06:45–07:15
Separated wet hygiene kits and shelter kits onto pallets in row A, marked WET – DO NOT ISSUE
Left the 2 wet water treatment unit boxes in row D, marked NOT TESTED
Closed the side door with a pallet and rope. No lock.
Told the cluster logistics officer by phone to ask the Logistics Manager about the shelter kits for Nhamatanda. Gave no figure.
recommendations: Logistics Manager to check and sign Recount 1 before figures go to the cluster
Test the 2 wet water treatment units before counting them as available
Report the missing items (80 shelter kits, 480 jerrycans, 200 hygiene kits) to the Security Focal Point
Get tarpaulin cover over rows C–E and a padlock on the side door today
fields.photosNote: 4 photos sent by WhatsApp: IMG-20270212-WA0012 to WA0015 (recount sheet pages 1–2, wet pallets in row A, side door). Voice note PTT-20270212-WA0016 (cluster logistics officer call).
fields.signature: A. Mabunda, Storekeeper. Logistics Manager sign-off: ________ (PENDING)

instructorNote: This is a clue inject. The verified numbers no longer match the 'available' line on the HCT pre-read, and the cluster is about to pledge kits against them. Watch whether LOG signs off the recount and leaves the 2 untested water treatment units out of 'available'. Then check that the IMO sends a written correction to the cluster information managers and the HC office before 08:30. That correction should count only usable stock, without the damaged or missing items. Also watch whether the CD gets the corrected figures and the SFP is told about the missing stock.
